realized_vol: population standard deviation of hourly close-to-close returns over the last 24 or 72 returns ending at signal close
atr24_over_close: arithmetic mean of true range over last 24 completed hourly bars divided by signal close
ema_ratio: causal recursive EMA12/EMA48-1 through signal close using alpha=2/(span+1), initialized from first available close
rsi14_scaled: simple 14-hour RSI from gains/losses ending at signal close, transformed as (RSI-50)/50
volume_z24_168: signal-bar quote volume minus mean of previous N completed bars, divided by population std of those previous N bars; current bar excluded from baseline
taker_imbalance_6h: arithmetic mean of the last six completed hourly taker imbalances including signal hour
funding_last: most recent funding rate with timestamp strictly before entry timestamp; zero only if no prior observation exists
funding_mean_24h: mean of funding observations in [entry-24h, entry); zero if none
target: open_{t+1+4h}/open_{t+1}-1, where signal bar t is completed and t+1 is the exact next hourly open
continuity: require exact 1h continuity across the previous 168 bars and through target exit; otherwise sample is skipped
missing_feature_policy: skip sample; no imputation other than explicitly defined zero for absent prior funding
